guide_solution: Causes of Road Accidents in Bangladesh At present road accidents are regular happenings in Bangladesh. Generally road accidents take place in the urban areas and in the highways. The causes of road accidents are reckless driving, brake failures of vehicles, over-taking of one vehicle by another, driving by unskilled (অদক্ষ) drivers. Over loading of vehicles is another reason for accidents. Another reason is violation (#897) of traffic rules. Even the police cannot control the traffic rule breakers. Sometimes pedestrians (পথচারী) are crashed under the wheels of heavy vehicles. Sometimes the speedy vehicles fall into the roadside ditch or into the river and thus kill the passengers on the spot. Many lives are nipped in the bud. Many a family loses the only eaming member. Many people become crippled. During the last vacation I met with an accident on my way to Rajshahi by bus. Luckily nobody was hurt. So road accident is like a curse in our life. This problem can be solved by all out efforts from both the , . authority and the general mass. To do so, first our general people have to be made aware. The drivers have to be skilled and they also have to avoid their overtaking tendency (প্রবণতা). And the authority should be more strict to enforce the rules. And these steps must be taken immediately to prevent road accidents. [Words : 213]

question_text: Write a paragraph. about 'A Village Doctor'. (DB 08) Ans. A Village Doctor (একজন 215) ভান্তার) A village doctor is a familiar (পরিচিত) figure to the villagers. His knowledge of medicine is very little. He only undergoes a few months' training under non-govt. LMF training center or under a medical practitioner. Then he starts his independent (স্বাধীন) practice. A village doctor is called a quack (হাহুড়ে S75). In his dispensary he gives advice and prescribes medicine for the patients (রোগী). He has an assistant in his dispensary. He gives medicine to the patients according to the prescription (ব্যবস্থাপত্র). He has one or two almirahs in his dispensary. He has not a large stock of medicines. He has only cheap and common medicines in his dispensary. After finishing his duty in his dispensary, he goes out to see patients in the village with a medicine bag. This bag, looks like a "First-aid" box. He usually goes on foot or a bicycle to visit his patients. In a word he is an -important and useful member of the village society. 39.

question_text: Write a paragraph. about 'A Bus Stand'. . 100 05: 08008) Ans. . A Bus-Stand (একটি বাসস্ট্যান্ড) Commonly a bus-stand is a place where buses stop and start from. Generally, it stands at the outskirts of a town or city. It carries a great value for the passengers of long drive. It is quite a crowded place. In the maximum bus stands there is a waiting room for the passengers. Passengers don't have to wait for long time for the buses. Passengers gather at bus stand to get into the bus when it comes. It is visible that both passengers and coolies are equally busy at the stand. Some passengers wait for buses for a while and go into the tea-stall for drinking a _ cup of tea. Most of buses cannot come to the station in time because of jam. It is sometimes seen that buses are overcrowded then the environment inside the buses is suffocating (শ্বাসবুস্ধকর). However, a bus-stand is a temporary shelter for passengers. In some bus stands there are counters for booking ticket. Passengers stand in a line for buying tickets. Sometimes some ill-tempered (বদমেজাভী) passengers break the line and quarrel among themselves. Many kinds of things are found at the bus stand. There are found road-side tea-stalls, other small shops, hawkers selling betel-leaf and cigarette at a bus stand. Magazine and seasonal (মৌসুমী) fruits are _ available here. Indeed it is a place of crowd. . 40.

question_text: Write a paragraph. about 'May-Day'. 10907) Ans. May Day (মে দিবস) May 1৮, International Workers Day, is observed as May Day. To commemorate the historic struggle of working people throughout the world the day is observed. From the beginning of the Industrial Revolution people in factories have worked very long shifts lasting up to fourteen or even more hours a day. In the 1880 a new . Movement (আন্দোলন) calling for an eight hour day inspired (অনুপ্রাণিত করা) both Labour Unions and unorganised জেসংগতিত) workers. The workers fought for some rights; a minimum wage, safety laws and the guarantee of eight hour workday. To establish these rights they launched a concerted movement against the prevalent (বিরাজমান) law and law enforcing and enacting agencies. As a result on May 3, 1889, police fired into a crowd of strikers at the McComick Harvest Machine Company, Chicago, killing at least one stricker, seriously wounding five or six others and injuring an undetermined number. All these are infeasible to be forgettable and all these have determined better working conditions, better pay and better lives*for today's workers and this is the importance of the day. May Ist, is now recognised in most countries of the world. 1185 words} 41.

guide_solution: My Favourite Game/ The Game I Like Most All games are not equally amusing and interesting to us. Among the games I have a great fascination for football which is a popular game all over the world. It is full of thrill for both the players and spectators. It is an excellent form of exercise that makes the players strong and stout. These are the reason for which I like football | . more than all other games. : , The game is played between two teams each consisting of eleven players. Of them there is a goalkeeper who prevents the ball from crossing the goalline. There are two full backs standing at a little distance from the goal posts. There are three half backs in a line midway between the forwards and backs who act both as defenders and offenders. There are five other players who play in the forward line. They try to push the ball through the goal posts. The whole game is divided into two equal halves with an interval of fifteen minutes. At the end of the first half each team changes its side.
